segments.title: The same desk, *now it moves*.
segments.zh: 还是那张书桌，现在它会动了。
segments.cap: Left is my site as it is today. Right is the same site, redesigned around how things move.
segments.capzh: 左边是现在的网站；右边是同一个网站，这次改的是东西怎么动。

beats.b: A first visit opens on a dark loading screen. A line of birds hops across.
beats.bzh: 第一次来，先是黑屏加载，一排小鸟跳过去。
beats.a: A first visit opens like an anime OP: **弗, 雷, 德, FRED**, then the things on the desk.
beats.azh: 第一次来，先放一段片头：弗、雷、德、FRED，再是桌上的东西。

beats.b: Then an iris wipe opens onto the desk.
beats.bzh: 然后一个圆形转场，露出书桌。
beats.a: Hard cut: the objects **fall onto the table**, then the 日常 · ep.27 card.
beats.azh: 硬切：东西一样样落到桌上，再是「日常 · ep.27」的卡片。

beats.b: The desk, with its labels.
beats.bzh: 书桌和它的标注。
beats.a: ep.27 is the number of essays. Come back in the same session and only the fall plays.
beats.azh: ep.27 是书架上的文章数。同一次访问里再回来，只放东西落下的那段。

replay.b: The same seconds on the old site: birds on a dark screen.
replay.bzh: 旧网站的同样几秒：黑屏上的小鸟。
replay.a: Slowed down: one name per cut. This is the only place the site gets loud.
replay.azh: 放慢看：一个镜头一个字。整个网站只有这里是吵的。

segments.title: From the desk to a page

beats.b: Point at the book on the desk and its pages turn.
beats.bzh: 指向桌上的书，书页翻动。
beats.a: The desk still does what it did: point at the book and its pages turn.
beats.azh: 书桌原来会做的事都还在：指向书，书页翻动。

beats.b: Click: a **hard cut** through a blank page, then the new page fades up.
beats.bzh: 点一下：硬切，中间闪过一张白页，新页面再淡入。
beats.a: Click: the **desk becomes the nav**. The table folds into the rule, the objects fly to their tabs.
beats.azh: 点一下：书桌变成导航。桌面折进那条横线，四样东西飞进各自的标签。

replay.b: Slowed down: the cut, the blank page, the fade.
replay.a: Slowed down: each object flies on its own arc. The book you clicked lifts highest.
replay.azh: 放慢看：每样东西走自己的弧线，被点的那本书飞得最高。

beats.b: A flat row of spines. Hovering one swaps the preview card on the right.
beats.bzh: 一排书脊。指到哪本，右边的预览卡就换成哪本。
beats.a: Point at a spine and the book **slides out**, turning its cover to you under a paper obi.
beats.azh: 指向书脊，书被抽出来，转过封面，腰封上写着这篇的简介。

beats.b: Chips filter the shelf. The books are redrawn in place.
beats.bzh: 点标签筛选，书架原地重画。
beats.a: Index tabs sit on the fore-edge. Pick one and the books **tip out, slide and drop in**.
beats.azh: 索引标签贴在书口。选一个，书会倒出、滑开、再落回书架。

beats.b: Years are chips too, one year at a time.
beats.bzh: 年份也是标签，一次只能选一年。
beats.a: Drag down the 正 ledger to pick **a span of years**. The tallies count the essays.
beats.azh: 在「正」字年表上一拖，就选中一段年份；笔画数就是篇数。

beats.b: Hovering changes nothing. The chosen chip turns coral.
beats.bzh: 指上去没有变化，选中的标签变成珊瑚色。
beats.a: Hover draws a **coral pen line**. The chosen tab keeps a wheat highlighter band.
beats.azh: 指上去，笔画出一道珊瑚色的线；选中的标签留着一道麦色荧光笔。

beats.b: The page fades up. The title is an animated three-colour gradient.
beats.bzh: 页面淡入。标题是一段流动的三色渐变。
beats.a: On first view a **小红花** is pressed onto the lead card, the way a teacher marks the best work.
beats.azh: 第一次看到时，主卡片上被按上一朵小红花，就像老师贴在最好的作业旁边。

beats.b: Pointing at the card straightens it and darkens its button.
beats.bzh: 指向卡片，卡片摆正，按钮变深。
beats.a: Point at the card and the flower pops up, then is pressed down again.
beats.azh: 指向卡片，小红花弹起来，又被按回去。

beats.b: The strip scrolls sideways, like a list.
beats.bzh: 卡片横向滚动，像一个列表。
beats.a: Drag the cork and let go. It carries on, and the cards **swing on their pins**.
beats.azh: 拖动软木板再松手，板子滑出一段，卡片在图钉上摆动。

beats.b: The + opens a torn note beside the card.
beats.bzh: 点「+」，卡片旁边展开一张撕边便签。
beats.a: Click a card to **unpin it**. It comes forward and a field note opens beneath it.
beats.azh: 点一张卡片，把它从图钉上取下来拿到面前，下面展开一页笔记。

beats.b: Close it and the note is gone.
beats.bzh: 关掉，便签就没了。
beats.a: “Pin it back” sends it home. The pin goes in, and the nearby cards sway.
beats.azh: 点「钉回去」，卡片回到原位；图钉按下去，附近的卡片跟着晃一下。

segments.title: Shooting · the darkroom and the line

beats.b: The prints are already there when the page loads.
beats.bzh: 页面一打开，照片就已经摆好了。
beats.a: On a first visit each print **develops**: blank, then grey, then colour.
beats.azh: 第一次来，每张照片都要显影：先是空白，再变灰，最后出颜色。

beats.b: Sweeping across the grid changes nothing.
beats.bzh: 指针扫过网格，什么都没变。
beats.a: A fast sweep across the line swings the prints on their pegs.
beats.azh: 指针快速扫过，照片在夹子上晃起来。

beats.b: Point at a print.
beats.bzh: 指向一张照片。
beats.a: A slow approach leaves the print still, and the pen underlines its caption.
beats.azh: 慢慢指过去，照片不晃，笔在说明文字下面画一道线。

beats.b: A click cuts to a dark lightbox.
beats.bzh: 点一下，直接切到黑底灯箱。
beats.a: A click **unclips** it. The peg comes along, and the rope springs up.
beats.azh: 点一下，照片被取下，夹子跟着走；绳子少了重量，往上一弹。

beats.b: Another click, and the lightbox is gone.
beats.bzh: 再点一下，灯箱消失。
beats.a: Click again: it flies home, the peg bites the rope, and the line sags back.
beats.azh: 再点一下：照片飞回去，夹子咬住绳子，绳子重新垂下来。

replay.b: The lightbox, slowed down: one cut.
replay.bzh: 放慢看灯箱：就是一刀切。
replay.a: Slowed down: the peg opens, the print lifts off, the peg closes on its top edge.
replay.azh: 放慢看：夹子张开，照片离开绳子，夹子再夹住照片的上沿。

beats.b: The field card lies flat under a **glare** that follows the pointer.
beats.bzh: 卡片平铺在页面上，指针到哪，白色反光就跟到哪。
beats.a: The specimen card waits in a kraft sleeve, one edge showing.
beats.azh: 标本卡插在牛皮纸卡套里，只露出一条边。

beats.b: Hovering tilts it a few degrees.
beats.bzh: 指针划过，卡片倾斜几度。
beats.a: Drag the edge: it sticks, catches on the lip, and **pops free** into your hand.
beats.azh: 拖住那条边：先卡一下，挂住袋口，再弹出来，落进手里。

beats.b: FLIP is a button, with a **shimmer** that never stops.
beats.bzh: 翻面靠一个按钮，按钮上的流光一直在闪。
beats.a: Drag the card and it turns over **where it is**; the radar draws itself.
beats.azh: 拖一下，卡片就在原地翻面；背面的雷达图一笔一笔画出来。

beats.b: Press it again to flip back.
beats.bzh: 再按一次，翻回来。
beats.a: Drag the other way and it turns back.
beats.azh: 往另一边拖，翻回正面。

beats.b: The card has nowhere to go.
beats.bzh: 卡片没有地方可收。
beats.a: Carry it onto the sleeve: the sleeve takes it half in, then it slides home.
beats.azh: 拖到卡套上，卡套先吞进一半；一松手，卡片滑回去。

beats.b: Scroll down: the cover and the title slide **under the nav**, which is transparent.
beats.bzh: 往下滚，封面和标题从透明的导航底下穿过去。
beats.a: Scroll down: the cover **dissolves into halftone** and the title lands in the header.
beats.azh: 往下滚，封面散成半调网点，标题落进页眉。

beats.b: The body text runs under the nav's buttons too.
beats.bzh: 正文也从导航的按钮底下穿过。
beats.a: The nav is solid paper. A pencil rail marks the sections in the left margin.
beats.azh: 导航是一张实纸。左边页边上，一条铅笔线标出各节。

beats.b: Hover a footnote number: nothing. The note waits in the margin in a hand font.
beats.bzh: 指向脚注编号，没有反应。注释用手写体待在页边。
beats.a: Hover a footnote: the pen **brackets the claim**, rings the number and pulls the note over.
beats.azh: 指向脚注：笔先框住那句话，圈上编号，再把注释拽过来。

beats.b: Citations are set in small handwriting, and some slide under the nav.
beats.bzh: 引文是小号手写体，有的还钻到导航底下。
beats.a: Hover a tick on the rail to read that section's first line.
beats.azh: 指向铅笔线上的刻度，能读到那一节的第一句。

replay.a: Bracket, ring, arrow: one stroke each. The slip swings in on its eyelet.
replay.azh: 括号、圈、箭头，各一笔。纸条挂在孔眼上，被拽过来时晃了一下。

segments.title: Between pages · tab to tab
segments.zh: 页面之间 · 标签到标签

beats.b: Point at the shooting tab.
beats.bzh: 指向「在拍」标签。
beats.a: Point at the shooting tab and the pen underlines it.
beats.azh: 指向「在拍」标签，笔在下面画一道线。

beats.b: Click: another hard cut.
beats.bzh: 点一下：又是一次硬切。
beats.a: Click: the **folder tab springs** across to the new page.
beats.azh: 点一下：文件夹标签弹到新的一页。

replay.note: replay · 0.35× speed · zoomed on the nav
replay.b: The same moment, zoomed in on the nav.
replay.a: Zoomed in: the tab springs past building and settles on shooting.
replay.azh: 放大看：标签越过「在造」，停在「在拍」。

segments.title: Between pages · back to the desk
segments.zh: 页面之间 · 回到书桌

beats.b: Back to the desk from the gallery.
beats.bzh: 从相册回到书桌。
beats.a: Back to the desk from the gallery.
beats.azh: 从相册回到书桌。

beats.b: Another hard cut, and the desk is simply there.
beats.bzh: 又一次硬切，书桌直接出现。
beats.a: The nav **falls back** into a desk: the rule sags, the table unfolds, the objects drop in.
beats.azh: 导航落回成书桌：横线下垂，桌面展开，东西掉回桌上。

beats.b: The desk is a small picture with four links under it.
beats.bzh: 书桌是一张小图，下面四个链接。
beats.a: The whole desk fills the screen. Its four objects are the doors.
beats.azh: 整张书桌铺满屏幕，桌上四样东西就是门。

beats.b: Swiping over the drawing does nothing.
beats.bzh: 在图上左右滑，没有反应。
beats.a: Swipe: the camera walks to the laptop, and it types the latest project.
beats.azh: 滑一下，镜头走到笔记本前，屏幕敲出最近的项目。

beats.b: Its camera flash and typing run on timers, whatever you do.
beats.bzh: 闪光和打字按定时器自己跑，与你无关。
beats.a: Portrait, camera, book: each one reacts when the camera settles on it.
beats.azh: 肖像、相机、书，镜头一停，它们各动一下。

segments.title: On a phone · the specimen card

beats.b: The card, with a shimmering **FLIP** button above it.
beats.bzh: 一张卡片，上方是一个闪着光的“翻面”按钮。
beats.a: The card sits in a kraft sleeve.
beats.azh: 卡片装在牛皮纸封套里。

beats.b: Dragging the card sideways does nothing.
beats.bzh: 横着拖卡片，没有反应。
beats.a: Drag it out sideways; the sleeve **steps aside** to the edge.
beats.azh: 横着把卡抽出来，封套让到屏幕边上。

beats.b: Tap FLIP to swap the faces.
beats.bzh: 按“翻面”，换到另一面。
beats.a: Tap the card: it turns over in place, and the radar is drawn in.
beats.azh: 点一下，卡片原地翻面，雷达一笔笔画出来。

beats.b: FLIP again to go back.
beats.bzh: 再按一次，翻回来。
beats.a: Drag it to the sleeve's edge and it slides back in.
beats.azh: 拖到封套那条边，卡片滑回去。

segments.title: My own drawings, *a pen*, paper and physics.
segments.zh: 我自己的画、一支笔、纸和物理。
segments.cap: No gradients, no glow, no glass. Every motion has a cause.
segments.capzh: 没有渐变，没有发光，没有毛玻璃。每个动作都有来由。
